description: CCSDS Space Packet and TM/TC Space Data Link framing. One case per Python test; `instances` are the framer objects the test created (with their configuration) and `steps` are the calls the test made on them, in order. State carries from one step to the next on the same instance. frame: input payload -> expected frame. deframe: input -> one packet (null when none), the bytes kept for the next call (leftover) and the bytes thrown away (discarded). deframe_all: same with every packet found. `warnings` are the messages the Python code logged during the step.

warnings: [WARNING] First Header Pointer beyond TM frame data field. Discarding frame and partial packet data.
[WARNING] First Header Pointer inconsistent with pending packet length. Discarding partial packet data.
[WARNING] Spanned packet exceeds maximum packet size. Discarding partial packet data.
[WARNING] TM frame loss detected. Discarding partial packet data.
